answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy leverages a high-cost Proof-of-Stake mechanism. Each agent must lock a substantial native token amount, acting as an economic barrier. Every legitimate interaction sends a distinct data pulse. An attacker requires a significant pearl of staked tokens for each fake identity, creating a market ripple from their capital acquisition. The cumulative financial burden for a large-scale attack rapidly becomes insurmountable, ensuring authenticity through economic scarcity.
